# Appendix {#sec-appendix}

## JavaScript syntax quick reference

| Task | Syntax |
|---|---|
| Declare constant | `const name = "opencode"` |
| Declare reassigned binding | `let count = 0` |
| Template string | `` `hello ${name}` `` |
| Strict equality | `a === b` |
| Optional access | `config.provider?.id` |
| Nullish default | `value ?? defaultValue` |
| Array map | `items.map((item) => item.id)` |
| Array filter | `items.filter((item) => item.enabled)` |
| Array flatMap | `items.flatMap((item) => item.children)` |
| Object copy | `{ ...old, title: "new" }` |
| Array copy | `[...items, next]` |
| Async function | `async function load() {}` |
| Await promise | `const value = await promise` |
| Dynamic import | `const { marked } = await import("marked")` |

## TypeScript syntax quick reference

| Task | Syntax |
|---|---|
| Type alias | `type ID = string` |
| Object type | `type User = { id: string }` |
| Optional property | `title?: string` |
| Union | `"idle" \| "running"` |
| Intersection | `A & B` |
| Generic | `function first<T>(items: T[]) {}` |
| Key union | `keyof T` |
| Property type | `T["id"]` |
| Array element type | `T[number]` |
| Type-only import | `import type { Info } from "./types"` |
| Literal preservation | `as const` |
| Shape check | `satisfies Config` |
| Unknown input | `input: unknown` |
| Exhaustive impossible | `value: never` |

## Control flow and looping quick reference

| Need | Syntax | Remember |
|---|---|---|
| Run a branch | `if (condition) { ... }` | Use explicit checks for arrays and objects |
| Small conditional value | `condition ? a : b` | Keep ternaries short |
| Many variants | `switch (event.type) { ... }` | Good for discriminated unions |
| Iterate values | `for (const item of items) { ... }` | Clear for ordered or sequential work |
| Loop by condition | `while (condition) { ... }` | Useful for streams and retries |
| Skip current item | `continue` | Keep the rest of the loop focused |
| Stop early | `break` | Use when later items no longer matter |
| Async iterable | `for await (const event of stream) { ... }` | Waits for each streamed value |
| Transform every item | `items.map((item) => next)` | Same output length |
| Keep some items | `items.filter((item) => keep)` | Predicate decides membership |
| Combine values | `items.reduce((acc, item) => acc, initial)` | Prefer clearer methods when possible |

## Array method decision table

| Need | Method | Remember |
|---|---|---|
| Transform every item | `map` | Output array has the same length |
| Keep some items | `filter` | Use a type guard when filtering optional values |
| One item to many items | `flatMap` | Good for nested lists |
| Find one item | `find` | Result may be `undefined` |
| Check membership by predicate | `some` | Returns boolean |
| Ensure all match | `every` | Empty array returns `true` |
| Combine into one value | `reduce` | Prefer clearer methods when possible |
| Sort without mutating | `[...items].sort()` | `sort()` mutates the array |

## Boundary decision table

| Boundary | Treat as | Common validation |
|---|---|---|
| JSON file | `unknown` | Effect Schema decode after `Bun.file(...).json()` |
| HTTP request body | `unknown` | Protocol or handler schema |
| Provider response | `unknown` or typed SDK output | Decode before storing or exposing as protocol data |
| Database row | Runtime data | Schema decode or repository-level normalization |
| Plugin input | `unknown` | Plugin command/input schema |
| Environment variable | `string \| undefined` | Explicit parse and default |
| Generated client output | Contracted data | Regenerate after public protocol changes |

## Runtime boundary checklist

Use this checklist whenever a value comes from JSON, a file, an HTTP request, a provider, a plugin, a database row, or an environment variable:

- Treat the first value as `unknown`.
- Decode or narrow before using fields.
- Convert strings to numbers or booleans explicitly.
- Decide whether `null`, `undefined`, and omitted fields mean different things.
- Preserve branded IDs by decoding or constructing them through the owning schema/helper.
- Do not use a TypeScript annotation as a substitute for validation.

## Async quick reference

```ts
// Await a promise
const value = await load()

// Concurrent independent work
const values = await Promise.all(
  inputs.map((input) => load(input)),
)

// All results even on failure
const outcomes = await Promise.allSettled(
  inputs.map((input) => load(input)),
)

// First settled promise (timeout pattern)
const result = await Promise.race([fetch(url), timeout])

// First fulfilled promise
const result = await Promise.any([mirror1, mirror2])

// External resolve/reject (ES2025)
const { promise, resolve, reject } = Promise.withResolvers()

// Promise chain
fetch(url)
  .then((res) => res.json())
  .then((data) => process(data))
  .catch((err) => handle(err))

// Async iterable
for await (const event of stream) {
  handle(event)
}

// Cancellation with timeout
const response = await fetch(url, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5000) })

// Custom cancellation
const controller = new AbortController()
fetch(url, { signal: controller.signal })
controller.abort()

// Stream reading
const reader = response.body.pipeThrough(new TextDecoderStream()).getReader()
while (true) {
  const { done, value } = await reader.read()
  if (done) break
  console.log(value)
}
```

## Effect quick reference

```ts
const program = Effect.gen(function* () {
  const service = yield* SomeService
  const value = yield* service.load(id)
  return value
})
```

```ts
const decode = Schema.decodeUnknownEffect(SomeSchema)
const value = yield* decode(input)
```

## Solid quick reference

```tsx
const [value, setValue] = createSignal("")
const normalized = createMemo(() => value().trim().toLowerCase())

return (
  <Show when={value()} fallback={<span>Empty</span>}>
    <span>{normalized()}</span>
  </Show>
)
```

## Repo command quick reference

```bash
# Typecheck a package
cd packages/opencode
bun typecheck

# Test a package
cd packages/core
bun test --only-failures

# Run app dev server
bun --cwd packages/app dev

# Run opencode dev
bun run --cwd packages/opencode --conditions=browser src/index.ts

# Regenerate client after public API changes
cd packages/client
bun run generate

# Regenerate legacy JS SDK
./packages/sdk/js/script/build.ts
```

## Dependency boundary quick reference

| Source area | May depend on | Must avoid |
|---|---|---|
| Schema | shared schema dependencies | Core, Server implementation |
| Core | Schema, local runtime services | Server-only HTTP handlers |
| Protocol | Schema and public contract code | Core implementation details |
| Server | Core, Protocol, Schema | Browser-only packages |
| Client runtime | Schema, Protocol, generated clients | Core, Server |
| Frontend app/UI | Client/protocol surfaces, UI packages | Server/Core internals |
| `sdk-next` | Client, Core, Server composition | Hand-edited generated surfaces |

## Public API change checklist

- Did the change touch public Protocol or Server `HttpApi`?
- If yes, run `bun run generate` from `packages/client`.
- Did it touch legacy JavaScript SDK output?
- If yes, run `./packages/sdk/js/script/build.ts`.
- Did generated files change only through scripts?
- Did the relevant package-local typecheck pass?

## Glossary

ESM
: ECMAScript modules. The `import`/`export` module system used by this repo.

Inference
: TypeScript deciding a type from an expression without an explicit annotation.

Narrowing
: TypeScript refining a union after checks like `typeof`, discriminant comparisons, or custom type guards.

Discriminated union
: A union of object types that share a literal field such as `type`.

Brand
: A type-level marker that distinguishes semantically different values with the same runtime representation.

Runtime schema
: A value that validates unknown data at runtime and often provides a static TypeScript type.

Effect
: A library for typed async workflows, errors, services, resources, and streams.

Layer
: An Effect value that provides a service implementation.

Signal
: A Solid reactive primitive with a getter and setter.

Generated code
: Files produced by scripts from schema/protocol definitions. Edit the source definitions, then regenerate.

## Final checklist for new contributors

- I can explain `null` vs `undefined`.
- I use `===`.
- I check array length explicitly.
- I understand that TypeScript types disappear at runtime.
- I can read a discriminated union.
- I know when to use `unknown`.
- I can run package-local typechecks.
- I know not to edit generated client files directly.
- I know that frontend runtime code must not import server/core internals.
- I can recognize Effect generator code and service access.
- I can read Solid signals and JSX control flow.
